config.description: Teammate partyData KIT BUFFS applied to a recipient active char (the inverse of the buff-clean FILLER set — the teammate INTENTIONALLY leaks its kit via setPartyChars + baked setBuffsSettings). Reps span the mechanism buckets: A=static (Zhongli universal res-shred), B=postEffect (Bennett base-ATK->flat-ATK, Kazuha EM->elemental-dmg%), C=multiplier (Shenhe Icy Quill ATK-scaled cryo bonus). Each fixture = the recipient's damage with the teammate buff ON. RED until P3.5.2 models partyData (engine: Task 2; data: Tasks 3-5). Source: CalcObject/Buffs.js:149-209, DbObject/Char.js:56-97.
